description: ¡Hola! Soy Kathleen Valentín, estudiante de Derecho de Perú, interesada en la ciencia, tecnología e innovación. Tengo habilidades en liderazgo, investigación, comunicación y trabajo en equipo. Me considero creativa, proactiva y comprometida. Busco personas con conocimientos en programación, ingeniería, diseño, IA, análisis de datos o ciencias STEM, con iniciativa, pensamiento crítico y ganas de aprender. ¡Creo que juntos podemos transformar ideas en soluciones innovadoras!
summary:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten is an interactive web experience that shares the stories of 15 NASA machines left behind on the Moon, Mars, and deep space. This includes the Apollo landers, lunar rovers, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Ingenuity, Dawn, and Kepler.

It tackles the challenge by giving each machine a voice. Users can tap on an explorer to learn what it was, why it was sent, what it achieved, and how its mission ended. They can follow a timeline from 1967 to 2021 and find landing sites on maps of the Moon and Mars. In the game "Mission Reactivation," users answer questions to wake each explorer. The explorers then light up in a museum, and every fact links back to NASA sources.

These machines are easy to forget after their missions wrap up. However, they carry the history of exploration and showcase the cost and effort behind it. By turning that history into a game, the project helps students and curious individuals remember the machines and understand why preserving space heritage is important.
details:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten takes you on an interactive journey through the machines humanity left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. Tap on each explorer to learn its story and wake it up with the "Mission Reactivation" game. Follow the timeline, complete your museum of 15 explorers, and discover that, even though they were abandoned, no one has forgotten them.

Short version: "15 sleeping machines on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. Wake them up, play, and don't let them be forgotten."
